name: Anzens USDA
oneLiner: USDA is Anzens' U.S.-MSB-licensed dollar stablecoin on Cardano, redeemable 1:1 against USD cash and Treasuries custodied by BitGo Trust.
collateral: USD and dollar-equivalent reserves including U.S. Treasuries, held in segregated accounts custodied by BitGo Trust (Qualified Custodian)
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 USD redemption through Anzens via KYC-verified bank transfers; minting and burning available to retail and institutional users in eligible U.S. states

applicabilityBasis.summary: USDA is an Anzens-issued U.S. dollar stablecoin designed for mint, burn, send, receive, and off-ramp payment flows.

genius.licensingRegulator: FinCEN MSB / state no-objection-letter context; BitGo Trust account context
genius.notes: Anzens describes USDA as 100% backed and issued by Anzens Inc., but Pharos found no public GENIUS issuer intent, PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, or official application source.

sourcesChecked: OCC GENIUS Act rulemaking bulletin and public releases
Anzens FinCEN MSB and state no-objection-letter disclosures
negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No public GENIUS issuer intent, token-specific PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, or official application source was located for USDA.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: USDA resolves to Yes because existing metadata classifies the asset as centralized and no manual override narrows that status.

mintAuthority.summary: USDA is issued by Anzens, a FinCEN-registered MSB; minting and redemption run 1:1 through Anzens' centralized backend via KYC-verified bank transfers against USD cash and Treasuries custodied at BitGo Trust on Cardano.

controls.label: Anzens issuance backend
controls.evidence: Anzens mints/burns USDA 1:1 against segregated USD reserves and Treasuries custodied at BitGo Trust, gated by KYC bank transfers; no permissionless or user-collateralized mint route exists on the Cardano native policy.

review.evidence: Anzens (FinCEN MSB) is the sole issuer of USDA on Cardano; mint/redeem is centralized 1:1 via KYC bank transfers against BitGo Trust-custodied reserves. No permissionless mint path is described in project materials.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Classification based on the Anzens issuer model in project materials; the Cardano native-asset minting policy controller and any policy keys were not independently resolved on-chain.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the Cardano minting-policy controller / policy keys for USDA before raising confidence.
